name: Statue of the Eternal Warrior
Description: A towering figure of a warrior mid-swing, forever frozen in the moment of victory. The bronze has aged to a deep green patina.

name: Statue of the Silent Mage
Description: A robed figure with hands raised, magical energy crackling between fingers. The crystal glows faintly in moonlight.

name: Statue of the Fallen King
Effect: Grants temporary leadership aura, +10 to all party stats
Description: A majestic king seated on a crumbling throne, crown tilted. Tears streak down the marble face.

name: Statue of the Rogue Shadow
Description: A hooded figure mid-leap, dagger drawn. The shadows seem to cling to the stone.

name: Statue of the Holy Paladin
Effect: Grants protection from undead, +20 Holy Resistance
Description: A gleaming paladin with shield raised, divine light radiating from the outstretched hand.

name: Statue of the Berserker Champion
Description: A wild-eyed warrior mid-roar, two axes crossed overhead. The stone pulses with primal energy.

name: Statue of the Wandering Monk
Description: A serene figure walking staff in hand, robes flowing despite no wind. Peace radiates from the stone.

name: Statue of the Dragon Slayer
Description: A scarred veteran standing atop a fallen dragon, spear plunged into the beast's heart.

name: Statue of the Oracle Maiden
Description: A blindfolded woman with hand extended, palm up. An ethereal mist curls from her fingertips.

name: Statue of the War Chief
Description: A massive orc with tusks bared, war hammer resting on shoulder. Battle scars cover every inch.

name: Statue of the Shadow Assassin
Description: A faceless figure emerging from darkness, blades extended from both sleeves. Impossible to look at directly.

name: Statue of the Sky Dancer
Description: A nimble figure suspended mid-air, ribbons trailing. The silver seems to defy gravity.

name: Statue of the God of War
Effect: +50 Attack, -20 Defense, battle rage for 10 minutes
Description: A towering god with six arms, each wielding a different weapon. War itself seems to emanate from the stone.

name: Statue of the Goddess of Beauty
Description: A breathtaking figure mid-dance, flowing garments revealing and concealing. All who gaze feel warmth.

name: Statue of the God of Death
Description: A skeletal figure in tattered robes, scythe resting across bony shoulders. The void stares back.

name: Statue of the Goddess of the Moon
Effect: Enhanced night vision, +20 Magic Resistance at night
Description: A silver-haired woman cradling the moon, stars woven through her hair. Glows brighter under moonlight.

name: Statue of the God of the Forge
Description: A burly god at the anvil, hammer raised mid-strike. Sparks frozen in mithril surround him.

name: Statue of the Goddess of Nature
Effect: Heals 5 HP per second for 5 minutes, calms animals
Description: A motherly figure with vines as hair, flowers blooming from her touch. The wood still grows.

name: Statue of the God of Storms
Effect: Call lightning, +30 Weather Magic for 1 hour
Description: A furious god wreathed in clouds, forked lightning crackling between clenched fists. Thunder booms nearby.

name: Statue of the Goddess of Wisdom
Description: A serene woman with an owl perched on her shoulder, scrolls clutched in her arms. Eyes hold infinite knowledge.

name: Statue of the God of Thieves
Effect: +35 Lockpicking, chance to find rare items
Description: A masked figure mid-step, coin slipping from one hand to another. Always seems to be watching.

name: Statue of the Goddess of Love
Description: A woman with arms outstretched, dove taking flight from her palm. Warmth radiates from the stone.

name: Statue of the God of Knowledge
Effect: Instantly learn any one spell, +30 Study Speed
Description: A figure with countless eyes, book floating before him. Words in forgotten languages cover every surface.

name: Statue of the Goddess of the Hunt
Description: A swift figure mid-stride, bow drawn. A great hound runs at her feet. The hunt never ends.

name: Statue of the Ancient Dragon
Description: A magnificent dragon coiled protectively around a hoard. Eyes seem to follow intruders.

name: Statue of the Eternal Phoenix
Effect: Resurrects once with full health when slain
Description: A blazing bird rising from flames, feathers dripping fire. The stone is warm to the touch.

name: Statue of the Sea Serpent
Description: A massive serpent coiled through coral towers, waves frozen in mid-crash. Salt clings to the stone.

name: Statue of the Griffin Guardian
Description: A proud griffin with wings spread, claws gripping the base. Guardian of high places.

name: Statue of the Unicorn of Purity
Description: A pristine unicorn mid-gallop, horn trailing rainbow light. The air feels cleaner nearby.

name: Statue of the Kraken
Description: Tentacles erupt from the base, beak open in a silent roar. Barnacles cling to ancient stone.

name: Statue of the Werewolf
Effect: +30 Beast Form for 1 hour during full moon
Description: A half-transformed figure, fur rippling across muscles. Eyes glow faintly in darkness.

name: Statue of the Hydra
Description: Nine heads frozen mid-strike, venom dripping from fangs. Cut heads appear to regrow slowly.

name: Statue of Time
Effect: Reverse time by 30 seconds, once per day
Description: An hourglass figure with clock faces for eyes, gears turning within. Sand flows in impossible directions.

name: Statue of Fate
Description: Three robed figures sharing one body, each facing a different direction. Thread connects to all who approach.

name: Statue of Entropy
Effect: Chance to instantly disintegrate one enemy
Description: A crumbling figure perpetually breaking apart, pieces floating in mid-air. Never fully falls.

name: Statue of Balance
Effect: Equalizes all stats, +20 to all resistances
Description: A figure split down the middle, light on one side darkness on the other. Neither half moves.

name: Statue of Eternity
Effect: Immunity to aging and time-based effects for 24 hours
Description: A perfect sphere with a figure suspended inside, neither moving nor still. Time stops around it.

name: Statue of Sorrow
Effect: Heals all allies within range, user takes 10 Emotional Damage
Description: A kneeling figure with face buried in hands, stone streaked with perpetual tears.

name: Statue of Hope
Effect: Removes all negative status effects, restores 50 HP
Description: A figure reaching upward, fingers stretched toward the sky. The stone glows with warm morning light.
